strategyReview: ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO remains our strongest signal with 4/4 live trades all winning and shadows accumulating +$0.78 total PnL. PC_RATIO_EXTREME_HIGH on OIL delivers steady profitability (60% win). WEEKEND_HL_FUNDING_REVERSION_LONG is eligible for live and consistently profitable across many assets with 74% win rate. Meanwhile, FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG on non-Gold assets (AMZN, HYPE) continues to drag performance, though Gold-specific trades do well. LLM_HYPOTHESIS remains disabled after large Oil losses. NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW is a shadow failure that should be retired.

failureClusters.theme: Funding Extreme Long on AMZN & HYPE Bleeds
failureClusters.evidence: AMZN: 7 trades, 29% win, -$0.11 total; HYPE: 6 trades, 33% win, -$0.10 total. Both assets are disabled but historical damage persists.
failureClusters.recommendation: Permanently keep FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG disabled on AMZN and HYPE; only allow GOLD where this signal is net positive.

failureClusters.evidence: Setup family: 89 resolved shadows, 37 wins, avg PnL -1.30%, large single losses (e.g., -51.79%).
failureClusters.recommendation: Retire the family and kill all associated hypotheses; the strategy is structurally losing.

failureClusters.evidence: 6 live OIL trades, 1 win, -$0.39 total, 17% win rate. Even after data cleanup, the disabled signal cannot recover.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep LLM_HYPOTHESIS disabled indefinitely; only allow a new, narrow, measurable Oil hypothesis to restart shadow testing.

newHypotheses.description: ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO on BTC refined entry: only enter when BTC is at least 2% below its 7d high (not near recent peak) and PM IV is in the lower 30th percentile (low implied movement expectations). This filters out high-probability touch scenarios.
newHypotheses.prediction: Sell YES on BTC one-touch contracts when filters are met; high probability YES value decays as spot stays below the high strike.

newHypotheses.description: BTC extreme PC ratio contrarian long with momentum filter: when IBIT put/call ratio is in its top 15th percentile (extreme high, signaling capitulation) and spot has positive 24h momentum (change >0.5%), go long.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot rises over next 7 days as excessive put positioning is unwound and momentum continues.

newHypotheses.description: Gold funding extreme long asset-specific short: when Gold perpetual funding rate is extremely high (>50% annualized) and spot is trading below its 24h SMA (momentum fading), short Gold.
newHypotheses.prediction: Gold spot price declines over the next 10 days as excessive long positioning unwinds.

hypothesisReviews.observation: BTC PM-IV expansion/reversion (60% win over 6 tests) shows promising edge but sample still small. Continue shadow testing and consider promotion once it reaches a higher trade count with stable performance.

BTC PM IV regime-relative compression (33% win over 4 tests) suffered one large loss; the concept may benefit from stricter regime filters (e.g., require IV at <15th percentile) to avoid premature entries.

journalEntry: Nightly review confirms ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO is our star performer and requires no parameter adjustment. PC_RATIO_EXTREME_HIGH on OIL remains a steady contributor. We retired NO_BIAS_ADJUSTED_GAP_SHADOW due to persistent losses. LLM_HYPOTHESIS stays locked. Three new hypotheses introduced: a refined BTC one-touch NO entry, a contrarian BTC PC ratio long with momentum, and a Gold funding extreme long short variant—each designed to capture proven dynamics with added filters. No parameter changes justified.
